scope: Complete Owner MFA audit -> trusted DB-only no-save Apply resolution -> caller status journey, with truthful recovered/lost-reply display. No SQL or public recovery grant changes.
verification_method: 25 fresh focused native journeys composed with the independently verified byte-identical 2405-case SQL/full225+41 baseline. This is not a fresh complete-suite rerun.
verified: Normal and lost resolution replies are reconciled by exact status reads, never automatic reposts. A rollback restores held work; duplicate resolution cannot release another unit.

The browser-facing Owner audit requires current membership and verified MFA. The private resolver separately refuses missing/stale/wrong/other-operation/provider-uncertain reviews without releasing work. Losing Owner membership prevents new metadata/audit access.
Seven app-role accounts, including the platform Owner, and anon/authenticated/service roles cannot directly execute the private resolver. No raw grant or browser recovery action is added.

A successful private resolution changes only the target extraction timestamp and inserts one immutable reconciliation row. Student/profile/content/evidence/application-audit state and all other extraction fields remain unchanged.
Old Apply requests are refused after invalidation; new explicit admission with a new operation/revision remains valid.
Actual TypeScript audit and status readers are coupled to native SQL for confirmed and lost audit replies. Strict no-save coherence rejects contradictory private outcomes before rendering.
The Owner panel keeps verified recovery visible after a lost review reply and avoids falsely claiming work is still reserved or that newer work has not started.
remaining: Other held/provider-backed recovery paths still need independent outcome/cessation evidence; no blind release, expiry or synthetic success.
Remaining Storage/service/scheduled/deployed-writer inventory and process/provider acceptance.
